{
  "function": "() =\u003e {\n  const dialog = document.querySelector('[role=\"dialog\"], .modal, kat-modal');\n  if (!dialog) return 'no dialog';\n  const allClickable = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button, div[role=\"button\"], a, kat-button, .module-card, [class*=\"module\"]'));\n  return allClickable.map(el =\u003e ({\n    tag: el.tagName,\n    className: el.className,\n    text: el.innerText ? el.innerText.trim().slice(0, 50) : '',\n    id: el.id\n  })).slice(0, 30);\n}",
  "pageId": 2,

}
